# Writing Skills for AI Agents

> 14 production writing-style skills and character frameworks for AI agents with dynamic GitHub skill loading.

## Installation
- Skills CLI: `npx skills add writing-skills`
- UVX: `uvx --from writing-skills writing-skills-mcp`
- NPX: `npx -y writing-skills`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://writing-skills.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://writing-skills.builditwithai.xyz

## Primary Tools
- `search_styles(query)`: Searches styles.
- `get_skill(style_name)`: Returns skill markdown.
- `install_skill(style_name)`: Installs skill into agent workspace.
- `list_styles()`: Lists all styles.

## Environment Variables
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`: Set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
